scope: Proposition 7.1 of the manuscript “A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Odd Characteristic” (preprints/A-Counterexample-to-Kaplanskys-Direct-Finiteness-Conjecture-in-Odd-Characteristic-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 197 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dc312586744d8d1b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let K be a field, let M ≥ 2 be invertible in K, and let ζ ∈ K have order M. For an integer q ≥ 0 put Zq = (Z/MZ)q and n = Mq. There is a finite group Λ of order Mn2 and a nonzero central idempotent f′ ∈ K[Λ] for which explicitly specified elements Ωuv, u, v ∈ Zq, form a basis of f′K[Λ] and obey ΩuvΩst = δvsΩut, ∑︂ u Ωuu = f′ . Thus Matn(K) ∼ = f′K[Λ] by its standard matrix units.
